message:
You know, I often chuckle at how unprepared I can be for the little surprises life throws my way. Just the other day, I found myself rummaging through the kitchen for a flashlight during a power outage, only to realize I had no batteries. It’s moments like those that remind me how useful it is to have a well-thought-out emergency kit ready to go. 

The beauty of having a few essentials on hand is that it can turn a potential scramble into a calm moment of reassurance. I encourage you to think about what you might need in your own home. After all, it’s much better to be ready than to have to improvise with a candle and a roll of duct tape!
